title: A Short Interview
text:
Maria is a chef in a small restaurant in Lisbon. In this interview, she talks about her first job in the kitchen. She started when she was sixteen, washing dishes on weekends. Today she works six days a week and loves her job.

The interviewer asks her what the hardest part of the job is. Maria says that the early mornings are difficult, but she likes to cook for people. She also says that her favourite dish is fish soup. At the end, she gives advice to young cooks: be patient and always learn something new.

questions.text: How old was Maria when she started working in the kitchen?
What can the reader guess about Maria from the passage?
options: She has been a cook for many years.
She has only cooked for one week.
She does not like her restaurant.

questions.text: Why does Maria give advice to young cooks?
options: She wants them to learn and be patient.
She wants them to stop cooking.
She wants to open a new restaurant.

vocabulary.definition: a meeting where someone asks questions to find out about a person
the one that you like more than all the others
able to wait calmly without getting angry
suggestions about what someone should do

paragraph_translations: Maria é chef em um pequeno restaurante em Lisboa. Nesta entrevista, ela fala sobre seu primeiro emprego na cozinha. Ela começou aos dezesseis anos, lavando pratos nos fins de semana. Hoje ela trabalha seis dias por semana e adora o seu trabalho.

A entrevistadora pergunta qual é a parte mais difícil do trabalho. Maria diz que as manhãs cedo são difíceis, mas gosta de cozinhar para as pessoas. Ela também diz que o seu prato favorito é sopa de peixe. No final, ela dá conselhos para jovens cozinheiros: seja paciente e sempre aprenda algo novo.
